newsitem.title: USA: Interpool Inc unit withdraws IPO filing.
newsitem.headline: Interpool Inc unit withdraws IPO filing.

text.p: Interpool Inc said Wednesday that its Interpool Ltd subsidiary withdrew the registration statement for its proposed initial public offering.
"With its recently renewed revolving credit facility, Interpool has a combined total of $240 million in cash, marketable securities and unused credit lines," said Interpool chairman Martin Tuchman.
"This will enable the company to fully fund the continued growth anticipated for its international container leasing business conducted by Interpool Ltd," Tuchman said.
In August, Interpool postponed the proposed offering, saying it did not believe it could obtain a fair price for the unit due to market conditions.
